Use case: stylized-concept. Production-ready hand-painted realistic 2D arcade fighting-game sprite atlas. Image 1 is the authoritative facial identity and wardrobe photo of ONE adult male fighter; ignore everyone else and the surroundings in the photo. Image 3 is the existing game's sprite sheet: match its illustrated shading, crisp silhouette, anatomy, camera and consistent warm lighting, NOT its character's face or clothes. Exactly 12 full-body sprites, FOUR columns by THREE rows, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Each body faces SCREEN RIGHT with face and chest turned slightly toward viewer. Wide 4:3 canvas, preferably 2048x1536. Equal cells, at least 7% clear margin around every body on all sides, no overlapping or touching other cells, whole hands and boots visible. Every standing body the same anatomical size; crouched and jumping bodies naturally lower, never enlarged. Flat pure saturated chroma GREEN #00FF00 fills all background and gaps. Green will be removed by the game shader. No grid, text, labels, ground shadows, floor, extra people, effects, blur, watermark or logos. Two arms, two legs.
Kozerod: foreground adult man with arms folded in Image 1. Preserve his young adult strong oval/square face, short sandy blond hair brushed to the side with short sides, straight nose and broad jaw, clean-shaven face, athletic average build. Black zip-up work jacket with a stand collar and small round blue-and-gold patch on upper sleeve without legible words, black straight trousers, black sporty shoes with white soles. Confident determined expression. No other people or background objects.
Twelve movement frames in reading order: 1 neutral fighting guard with fists raised, knees flexed; 2 same guard breathing in; 3 guard subtle weight shift; 4 high block both forearms protect head; 5 low crouching guard, one knee nearly ground, lowered head; 6 airborne compact jump with both knees tucked and fists guarding; 7 through 12 SIX successive distinct combat shuffle walking keyframes toward SCREEN RIGHT, alternate feet forward and together, knees continuously flexed, fists up. Frame 12 reconnects to frame 7. Keep each body fully isolated within its cell. No props.
There are THREE input images: first is ONLY Kozerod's reference, second is ONLY Tsvetkov's reference, third is the game's STYLE example. Generate ONLY kozerod. Ignore the other man's photograph.
